## 席位核对

L1 (L1-e) on head `d78b61b961194a1cc58e3738bccf3b3d363931c6`, card #36362: **ACCEPT**.

**Checklist**
- Shape and card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36397`, CLEAN, 13 items): open, draft, base `main`; first line `Fixes #36362`, no closing keyword near another card. `Fixes` is right: the card asks only for the mode shell and the extension point (要做的 7), and this PR delivers items 1 to 7. The newest `Claim:` (7076713389) names this branch.
- Scope: 23 files, all in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/{layout,chrome}` and `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales`, inside the claim's file surface. No `content/docs/releases/` path. No one-off script in the diff.
- Changeset: `.changeset/36362-runtime-design-mode.md`. `@object-ui/i18n` is published and gains 3 keys (`designMode.title`, `.leaveUnsaved`, `.saveFailed`), so patch with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so its entry ships nothing. I checked each sentence of the changeset against the diff: the gate (`useAppStudioEntry` edit posture, unchanged), the bar's three items, kept across pages / off on another app / never on a phone, Favorites hidden, Save off when nothing is staged, the ask on tab close / link out / app switcher but not on an in-app link, and the read-only eye entry unchanged. All of it is true of the code.
- Gates at this head: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are `success`. `dogfood` is not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm).

**Spot checks**
- `designMode.tsx`, the save loop: it commits over a snapshot, in insertion order. A throw toasts `designMode.saveFailed`, returns `false` and leaves the failed change and every later one staged, with the mode on. A change re-staged while its commit was in flight stays staged (the identity check before the delete). The mode goes `OFF` only when nothing is left. On a change of app, the reset happens during render (`setHeld(OFF)`), so the previous app's staged changes are dropped. The app switcher still asks first, because the `keeps` check for another app is `false`.
- `unsavedEdits.ts`: `keeps` narrows only the click guard (`latestMessage(url)` skips a keeping registration). `beforeunload` still fires on any registration (`registrations.size`), and `confirmUnsavedLeave` still calls `latestMessage()` with no url, so every registration still asks. The old signature is still accepted (the option is optional).
- `isPageOfApp`: the prefix comes from the address on screen, so a basename counts, and `/apps/crm2/…` is not a page of `/apps/crm`.
- `ShellPageActions.tsx`: the `view` posture (read-only package) returns before the new branch, so the eye entry is unchanged. A member gets no `entry`. 「Edit app」 is hidden while the mode is on.
- Tests: `designMode-36362.test.tsx` has 13 cases, covering each card item and the acceptance lines (a failed commit, another app, a phone, beforeunload, in-app versus out-of-app links). The ablation in the body (`keeps` disabled → 3 tests red) is a positive control for the new guard. The new i18n keys are present in all 11 locales; `common.cancel` and `common.save` already exist.
- The screenshots in `shots/36362` (before/design at 1280 and 1440) show the bar with exactly 「Design mode」 「Cancel」 「Save」 (Save greyed), on one line, with the sidebar below it and the page header uncovered. 「Edit app」 is shown in the before state.
- SQL push-down: not applicable (a UI-only diff, no data reads added).

**Deviations / owed before ready**
- The PR body's Verification paragraph says the screenshots are "attached to the os-dev report on #36362". The report (7077673915) says instead that they are held in the project thread. The body sentence is false as written. Correct it to say where the images actually are, as a body-only edit through the relay (no head change). The card's acceptance line 「PR 正文附模式里和平时的截图各一张」 cannot be met literally from a cloud container, because there is no upload route. The seat should note this when it flips ready.
- Noted, not a defect: only the `edit` posture enters the mode in this PR. Read-only/installed apps keep the eye entry, and the report routes that to #36363's PR.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `d78b61b961194a1cc58e3738bccf3b3d363931c6`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Read: card #36362 (body + all 4 comments: notice, claim, triage, os-dev-report), PR #36397 body and its 23-file list, the net diff `origin/main...d78b61b961`, and the 58 check-runs on the head (45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing; Check Changeset, Type Check UI, Test UI 1-16, Lint UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates all success).

- **`@object-ui/i18n` gains 3 keys — right.** `designMode.title`, `designMode.leaveUnsaved`, `designMode.saveFailed` are added to all 10 hand-written locales (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans), plus zh-Hant (header: generated from zh-Hans.ts) carrying the converted strings. The package is published (no `private`; `files` ships `dist`, `CHANGELOG.md`), so this is a real widening of the shipped catalogue and of the exported `TranslationKeys = typeof en` (ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:6569). It is the same additive shape as every key addition (precedent .changeset/33865-package-create-toast.md, same two packages, patch). The changeset body names all three keys. `common.cancel`/`common.save`, used by the bar, already exist on main.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` adds no package-level public surface — right, and the PR/changeset describe it so.** `useDesignModeChange`, `useDesignMode`, `useDesignModeActive`, `useDesignModeController`, `DesignModeProvider`, `isPageOfApp`, `DesignModeChange`, `DesignModeValue` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designMode.tsx:53-237), `UnsavedEditsOptions` and the new optional `options.keeps` on `registerUnsavedEdits` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/unsavedEdits.ts:71, :155) are module exports only. None is re-exported from src/index.ts, layout/index.ts or chrome/index.ts. The entry still exports only `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` and `confirmUnsavedLeave` (src/index.ts:199), with signatures unchanged. The package is `private: true` besides, so nothing reaches npm. The extension point is internal to app-shell, which fits card item 7 (later cards in the same package stage through it), and the changeset claims no app-shell exports. `keeps` is optional and per-registration. `latestMessage()` with no url still asks for every registration, so `confirmUnsavedLeave` and `beforeunload` are unchanged for existing callers: widening only.
- **No accept-set change.** No `packages/spec` path, schema, metadata key or governed path is in the diff; `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.
- **The user-visible change ships through `@object-ui/console`**, which takes app-shell as a devDependency and bundles it, and which the changeset does not name. Nothing is lost: console is in the same `fixed` group as `@object-ui/i18n`, so it bumps with it, and its `files` ships no CHANGELOG.md. Precedent 33865 has the same shape. Not a finding.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` and `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` are right. Per AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3, the level follows the Metadata-protocol kind: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships patch. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right: the diff widens a published package's surface (the i18n catalogue and `TranslationKeys`). The line is carried at line start in both the PR body and the changeset body, beside `Metadata-protocol: none`, and both agree with each other and with the claim's declaration. Listing the private app-shell is allowed (`privatePackages.version: true`, app-shell not in `fixed`) and has precedent. No major and no BREAKING banner, and none is owed. Check Changeset is success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty; nothing to answer.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (reach): showcase and installed read-only apps keep the eye entry and do not enter the mode. This matches the card ("现有的显示条件不放宽"). Whether installed apps should enter the mode for menu editing is routed to #36363's PR, and the claim and the PR body both send it to the seat. Carried, not escalated here.
- Card acceptance, on the declaration face: "直接输入带模式参数的地址也进不了模式" holds by construction (the mode has no address, designMode.tsx module doc). Who may enter is unchanged (`useAppStudioEntry` edit posture). The mode is off on a phone (`enabled: !phone`). The card's "没有核对的" items (the `edit-app/:editAppName` route, whether others see a save live) are untouched by this PR, and nothing here depends on them.
- SQL push-down: n/a. No data access, no id materialisation and no join in the diff. The extension point stores opaque `commit` closures, and this PR stages none.
